item.text: I’m opening the bulletin and searching for the currency-and-coin figure, then I’ll extract the most recent per-capita amount directly from the text.
`rg` isn’t available here, so I’m switching to `grep` and `sed` to locate the relevant passage and the reporting date.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc 'grep -n -i -E "per capita|currency and coin|circulation|coin in circulation" /mnt/data/LSF/data/officeqa/text/treasury_bulletin_2013_06.txt | head -n 50'
